title: ContextWell Lab Joins IASEAI as an Affiliate
description: ContextWell Lab is pleased to announce that it has joined the International Association for Safe & Ethical AI (IASEAI) as an affiliate. This affiliation connects ContextWell Lab with an international community working to advance safe and ethical AI through research, policy, education, and collaboration.

title: ContextWell Lab Launches New Research Initiative
description: Announcing our latest research program focused on embedding well-being as infrastructure in educational systems across three continents.

title: White Paper Published: Well-Being as Embedded Infrastructure
description: Our foundational white paper is now available on Zenodo, outlining the structural framing of well-being and human oversight as infrastructure for AI-mediated systems.

title: Healthcare Partners Join ContextWell Collaboration
description: Leading healthcare institutions commit to pilot capacity-building programs designed by ContextWell Lab, bringing research into practice across clinical settings.

title: New Publication in PLOS ONE
description: Our exploratory sequential mixed-methods study on AI for contextual well-being in medical education is now published and open access.

title: ContextWell Joins Global Well-Being Alliance
description: We are proud to become a founding member of the International Alliance for Well-being in Intelligent Systems, advancing coordinated research and policy.
